oil.when: 2007 (GM-based XL7 with the engine oil life system, reset with the accelerator pedal)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the engine off, turn the key to RUN.
Within five seconds, push the accelerator pedal slowly all the way to the floor and let it up, three times. The change engine oil light flashes while the system resets.
When the light stops flashing, turn the key to LOCK.
Start the engine. If the change oil light or CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message comes back and stays on, the reset did not take: repeat the steps.
oil.note: Reset it at every oil change, even one done before the reminder came on. If it gets reset by mistake, have the oil changed within 3,000 miles of the last service.

tpms.when: 2009 (tire pressures shown on the driver information center)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire placard on the driver's door jamb.
Turn the ignition on and drive. Once each tire is at the right pressure, the low tire pressure light and the check-tire message clear on their own; there is no reset button.
You can confirm the readings by pressing the vehicle information button until the front and rear tire pressure screens appear.

If the tires were rotated or a tire or sensor was replaced, the system has to relearn which sensor sits at which corner. A Suzuki dealer can do this with a tire pressure tool, and the owner's manual also describes a learn mode started from the information center.
tpms.note: SERVICE TIRE MONITOR SYSTEM, or dashes instead of pressures, means a sensor is missing or not working, which adding air will not fix; see a dealer if it stays. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: The 2007 to 2009 XL7 is built on a GM platform and uses GM's engine oil life system. The 2009 manual moves the oil life reset to the OIL LIFE screen in the information center menu; those steps were not confirmed here.
